==Description==
'''Hops''' is a narrator that appears in [[Story Mode|Story]] mode.

==Appearance== 
'''Hops''' takes the appearance of a soldier wearing a green shirt, green vest, dark green pants, black shoes, beret and belt.

==Trivia==
*In [[Off The Rails]], it was revealed that Hops got his nickname by taking the fall of [[Soldier (Narrator)|Soldier]] that pranked the NCO in basic. As a punishment, they tied his legs together and made him jump like a rabbit while the rest of the troops hunted him down for a week straight.
